name: Ōsato (Saitama, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōsato town emblem in white: an outlined cog-like device enclosing the character 里.
history: Flag of the former town of Ōsato in Saitama Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01. The flag was adopted on 1 October 1987; the emblem dates from 1 January 1955.

features.role: Ōsato town emblem — an outlined cog-like device enclosing the character 里
